import json
cap={'东港':9,'西湾':6,'南站':9,'北仓':6}
# 11日：站,开班实占,锁定,基础额度,兑入,批文
info={'J01':('东港',7,0,5,0,'7003'),'J02':('东港',0,0,6,0,'7013'),'J03':('东港',1,1,4,4,'2020'),
'J04':('西湾',0,0,5,3,'7032'),'J05':('西湾',5,0,4,0,'7043'),'J06':('西湾',0,0,2,3,'7052'),
'J07':('南站',7,2,6,1,'7063'),'J08':('南站',0,0,2,0,'7073'),'J09':('南站',1,0,5,5,'2080'),
'J10':('北仓',5,1,4,0,'7093'),'J11':('北仓',0,0,5,0,'2100'),'J12':('北仓',0,0,3,3,'2110')}
pri={}
T={}
for st,c in cap.items():
    ks=[k for k in info if info[k][0]==st]
    for k in ks:
        _,occ,lock,b,dx,liu=info[k]
        p=int(liu in ('7003',) and 1) # placeholder
    ks2=sorted(ks,key=lambda k:(0,k))
for k,v in info.items():
    _,occ,lock,b,dx,liu=v
    base_pri={'J01':1,'J02':2,'J03':2,'J04':3,'J05':2,'J06':2,'J07':1,'J08':2,'J09':1,'J10':1,'J11':3,'J12':1}[k]
    pri[k]=base_pri-1 if dx>0 else base_pri
for st,c in cap.items():
    ks=sorted([k for k in info if info[k][0]==st],key=lambda k:(pri[k],k))
    avail=c-sum(info[k][2] for k in ks)
    for k in ks:
        _,occ,lock,b,dx,liu=info[k]
        net=max(0,b+dx-lock); add=min(net,avail); avail-=add
        T[k]=lock+add
    print(st,'容量',c,'可用',c-sum(info[k][2] for k in ks),'顺序',[(k,pri[k]) for k in ks],'→',{k:T[k] for k in ks})
print('目标',T,{st:sum(T[k] for k in T if info[k][0]==st) for st in cap})
print('减',[(k,info[k][1],T[k]) for k in sorted(T) if T[k]<info[k][1]])
print('增',[(k,info[k][1],T[k]) for k in sorted(T) if T[k]>info[k][1]])
print('不动',[k for k in sorted(T) if T[k]==info[k][1]])
json.dump({'T':T,'pri':pri,'info':{k:list(v) for k,v in info.items()},'cap':cap},open('scratch/day11.json','w'))
EOF
